subject: Shallow Depth Reported - Hecate Strait
text:
Shallow Depth Reported - Hecate Strait
Shallow depth reported in Louise Narrows, south of Carmichael Passage at  52 57.272N 131 54.137W at 130050 UTC Mar 2026. Area has been silting in and has a reduced depth of 1.07 meters causing a hazard to navigation.
